items.title: John Beal interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2024
items.q: I remember a story from Norman Simmons talking about hearing Duke’s music

ctx.x: Well that one they put a pick-up on the bass which I wasn’t happy about but this particular one they’ll use microphones. The microphone gets more or less accurate sound, you know I mean let’s face it, recordings — I want to say that all Duke Ellington’s recordings you can really hear the bass on every one going all the way back. You know? He made sure the bass was not buried.
I remember a story from Norman Simmons talking about hearing Duke’s music and the bass coming through those big Zenith speakers and he went like this, and it obviously made an impression on him.
Yeah. Well I’m trying to remember — the bass player with Brubeck, Eugene Wright.
